name: gharoo-care
description: Gharoo Care - Full Stack Repair Service Application

scripts.start:clients: npm run build && npm run dev:clients
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:user && npm run build:admin && npm run build:service-man
scripts.build:user: npm ci --prefix Gharoo/Gharoo_client --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix Gharoo/Gharoo_client
scripts.build:admin: npm ci --prefix client --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:service-man: npm ci --prefix service-man-client --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix service-man-client
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:server"
